entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer for AI Agents. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that delivers memory, RAG, and user profiles via a single API. It features a custom vector graph engine and supports multi-modal extraction for PDFs, images, videos, and code.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that functions as an open-source context database using viking:// URIs. It employs tiered L0/L1/L2 loading layers to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for OpenClaw/Hermes Agents that provides synthesized answers with citations and gap analysis. It utilizes PGLite for local deployment and creates typed edges for a self-wiring knowledge graph.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for learning through long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is available via Python and Node.js client SDKs and supports Docker-based deployment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using git-like version control. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system that utilizes a single SQLite database for sub-millisecond performance. It includes episodic compression and temporal knowledge graph capabilities.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It includes CLI tools for solving, simulating, and investigating tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based context engine to ensure no message is lost. It utilizes a SQLite message store with FTS metadata to build depth-aware summary nodes.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted memory backend for Hermes Agent that enables private cross-session persistence. It supports OpenAI-compatible LLM providers or local inference servers via a Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis setup.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems that stores memory as plain-text YAML files on a local disk. It supports Hermes and provides a Python SDK for LangChain and llama.cpp.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer provides portable identity, memory, and secrets for agents including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It includes a dashboard and tools to inspect, edit, and repair memory.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that uses hybrid retrieval with BM25 and vector search without cloud dependencies. It integrates via MCP and plugins, utilizing a local GGUF observer model to capture decisions.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It is a native plugin for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems designed to reduce prefill latency.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: A durable, file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family including an MCP server and a Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every recall. It supports embedded in-process mode or an HTTP backend and tracks contradictions through resolution primitives.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp and functions as an MCP-native server.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets per query.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system that utilizes semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia with OCR support and bidirectional edge tags.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces tool-schema overhead in Hermes Agent v0.14.0 using local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard to track estimated savings in prompt tokens.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to minimize the context window requirements. It implements the Model Context Protocol and supports encrypted persistent memory via the Perseus Vault.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: A daemonless, long-term memory solution that stores information as inspectable Markdown files. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin using a single.lbdb embedded graph database for storage. It features importance-weighted recall and supports BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory featuring real event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides an audit trace of prefetch operations via a trace.jsonl log.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through semantic search and provenance tracking. It utilizes automatic memory mirroring from Hermes native tools and supports session snapshots with TTL.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server facilitates payments for APIs and AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families. It integrates with Hermes to enable self-charging capabilities.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, featuring configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides tools for searching, fetching, and traversing local artifact graphs. It includes automatic generation of tool-routing knowledge via OKFs and supports proactive routing through an installable skill.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin offers private local code memory for repositories, supporting semantic and literal code search. It enables grounded Q&A with file-and-line citations running locally over localhost.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It utilizes a hybrid search combining BM25, vector, and graph methods alongside automatic context checkpointing.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native long-term memory supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It includes MinHash for near-duplicate detection and features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest by default.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides an agentic software development methodology that enforces a red-green-refactor test-driven development cycle. It utilizes subagents for two-stage review implementation plans and integrates with coding harnesses like Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first design and prototyping system supports exports for HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4. It features a design system via DESIGN.md files and is compatible with OpenAI-compatible endpoints through BYOK.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides 817 production-grade skills across 29 security domains, mapped to six major frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. These structured cybersecurity skills are compatible with Hermes Agent and over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the generation of editable.drawio files from Mermaid text or natural language descriptions. It supports 11 diagram type presets and includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns using 57 pattern categories. It supports Rewrite, Detect, and Edit modes and is compatible with Hermes and Cursor.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project facilitates collective skill evolution for shared user teams through an Agentic Evolver. It provides automated skill deduplication, quality improvement, and unified skill libraries across multiple agents and devices.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys. It is compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents and supports installation via skills.sh.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals through natural-language mandates and escrow. It includes a master router, connector skills, and vendored official protocol skills.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation, offering slash commands to manage and save detected patterns.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set provides YouTube transcript, search, channel, and playlist capabilities without using yt-dlp. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project offers type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI using modular packages of instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This skill enables the dynamic generation of custom analytical lenses via the /prism-scan command. It includes seven pre-built prisms and provides constraint reporting to identify analysis blind spots via /prism-reflect.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro serves as a harness for long-running AI agents using a three-level work model. It supports file-backed and SQLite-backed cards and provides a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by weaving code and documentation into.lit.md files. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs source file edits back to the document.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin provides cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills provide integration for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds following the AgentSkills specification. They include specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It includes API integration patterns for polling, webhooks, error handling, and JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files from repositories or documentation URLs. It provides provenance via file:line citations or documentation URLs to create agentskills.io-compliant skills.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io is a registry of reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, complex multi-step tasks. It provides real-time tracking of progress and decisions alongside built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This skill implements a progressive MCP client with three-layer lazy loading to minimize token usage. It utilizes a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill manages files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a single Rust binary that functions as a workflow language for AI. It features static auditing for cost, permissions, and types, and produces hash-chained, tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a 5-layer intelligent skill retrieval system using hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls and features graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites based on model family and reasoning capability while tracking quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This tool performs adversarial bug-hunting code reviews using three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases, exploitability, and integration risks. It utilizes a deterministic pre-scan layer and a feedback MCP server to generate suppression rules for false positives.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io integrates with MCP and Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill employs a three-agent swarm targeting hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness through a risk-tiered triage system. It includes language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures to include multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol and a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub enables community skill browsing, searching, and one-click installation via the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates structured Chinese news reports ranging from global to street-level scales. It includes quality gates, AI analysis, and integrates user interests via semantic memory for search expansion.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes. These packages are updated automatically on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android and configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: This is a zero-install desktop GUI for Windows that requires no admin rights. It features an integrated workflow engine for automated multi-step pipelines and includes a toolset with TTS, Music, and ComfyUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project provides an automated Termux-based installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables deployment on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports configurable gateway mode.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project sandboxes Hermes Agent using hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restriction of network and filesystem access through configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration. It supports hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane allows for the deployment, monitoring, and operation of OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It manages separate workspaces and identities, hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework decomposes financial trading tasks into specialized roles, such as fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts. It supports multiple LLM providers and local Ollama models to manage multi-agent workflows.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables users to dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, and monitor spend. It supports various frameworks including CrewAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen through a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini. It offers optional sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template utilizes a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This control room template uses a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for orchestrator-to-specialist delegation. It provides bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool allows for the construction of autonomous AI agent swarms with durable agent memory and MCP tool integration. It supports over 23 LLM providers and provides visual org charts for agent team delegation.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous task status and review queues. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This framework coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols for local tool and communication handling, featuring a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents competing as two different AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for visualizing tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: This tool routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code using ACP-style delegation. It prevents parent context pollution through isolated workflows and enforces safety via configurable timeouts and output character limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This project provides a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph via an MCP server to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent and other coding agents. It supports multiple languages including TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, and C# through automatic project indexing and synchronization.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A cross-platform CLI tool featuring a native Rust TUI for tracking token usage. It monitors multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes, Claude Code, and Gemini.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This tool acts as a local trace viewer to inspect API traffic, including system prompts, tool calls, and streaming responses. It supports clients like Hermes Agent and Cursor, and can export local traces to self-contained HTML viewers.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in UI building. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Claude.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build, ship, and operate applications. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows for autonomous execution on laptops or a VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A community CLI tool used to customize the Hermes terminal UI. It allows for the customization of ASCII art banners, spinners, and banner colors using YAML-based configuration.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous AI agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and commerce via Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without OAuth or separate processes and includes MLOps tools for RL training and GGUF inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP. It features a visible UI for real-time AI supervision and includes session management and a research desk.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings. It includes 40+ pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance, with automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A TAW Agent framework that enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configuration and skills. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents and supports custom instructions and project-local memories.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for the hermes-agent stack and 12+ supporting services. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A static linter designed for AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It uses structural heuristics and static regex to score files without requiring model or API calls.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A migration tool designed to move SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps credentials and configurations into Hermes YAML and JSON formats.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides automated health monitoring and self-healing for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a beta Hermes plugin that exports telemetry for tool calls and API requests.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A Tauri 2-based cross-platform manager for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides an all-in-one interface to manage Hermes Agent alongside other agentic tools and CLI models.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork app for macOS, Windows, and Linux that includes a built-in agent engine with file access. It specializes in automating the creation of Word, Excel, and PPT documents.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A Python and vanilla JavaScript web interface that provides full parity with the Hermes CLI experience. It features a three-panel layout combining chat with workspace file browsing.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app focused on the initial setup of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider configuration. It includes a GUI for managing tools, sessions, and chat across multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A web dashboard featuring usage analytics, scheduled jobs, and profile-scoped file management via local SQLite storage. It provides unified configuration for channels including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a PTY terminal, Monaco editor, and an MCP catalog. It implements Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It provides native views for Kanban, skills, and cron jobs, alongside an embedded terminal for system repair.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust that supports Windows and macOS. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime and supports Markdown and LaTeX rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension for Chrome and Edge that connects browser context to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It includes Hermes Web for full-page workspace sessions.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard featuring tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health. It includes an MCP server control plane to manage server lifecycles.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A local-only macOS session browser and cockpit that tracks quota burn-rates per session. It supports Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs including Codex, Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot CLI.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for Hermes Agent running on SSH hosts and Orgo cloud computers. It offers one-click automated installation on cloud VMs and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: This OpenTUI-based terminal dashboard consolidates Hermes Agent chat, sessions, and configuration into a single interface. It features integrated kanban boards for managing agentic tasks and an extensible Eikon avatar system with catalog browsing.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A React-based mobile-first SPA designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. The interface supports terminal chat with streaming responses and file attachments, while allowing for five concurrent background agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A no-install, admin-free Windows desktop application that provides a GUI for Hermes Agent without requiring Docker. It includes a workflow engine for multi-step automation and 100 tools, including extensions for TTS, Music, and ComfyUI.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface designed for self-hosted AI assistance. It provides real-time log streaming and chat alongside a task tracking dashboard, file browser, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard provides real-time monitoring of session activity and cost tracking. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, as well as read-only monitoring of environment variables and configuration.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring a chat-first interface with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client designed for orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and supports streaming SSE responses and model switching.
